mitrasova-pos.title: Mitrasova POS
mitrasova-pos.summary: Reliable Offline-First Cashier System with Supplier Consignment Management, Multi-Branch Stock Synchronization, and Automated General Ledger.
mitrasova-pos.description: Mitrasova POS is a next-generation smart point-of-sale software engineered for retail, wholesale, and multi-outlet enterprises. Built with an Offline-First architecture that guarantees zero-latency checkout during network outages, automated supplier consignment revenue splits, cross-branch inventory sync, and a comprehensive accounting engine (balance sheet, P&L, and general ledger).

specs.label: Accounting Engine
specs.value: Balance Sheet, General Ledger, Profit & Loss

features.title: Offline-First Mode & Automated Cloud Sync
features.description: Cashiers continue processing thousands of transactions seamlessly without internet interruptions. All records automatically sync to central servers once connection is restored.

features.title: Supplier Consignment & Revenue Share Engine
features.description: Manage consigned inventory intake, automated commission splits upon sale, track item returns, and generate accurate periodic supplier settlement invoices.

features.title: Integrated Accounting & General Ledger
features.description: Automated journal entries for all sales and purchases, trial balance sheets, general ledger, periodic profit & loss statements, and real-time margin analytics.

features.title: Multi-Branch Stock Sync & High-Speed Receipt Printing
features.description: Monitor stock levels across all branch stores and warehouses, execute inter-outlet stock transfers, print thermal receipts over Bluetooth/LAN, and manage cashier shifts.

faqs.question: Does Mitrasova POS support consignment (titip jual) inventory management?
faqs.answer: Yes! Mitrasova POS features an integrated consignment engine to maintain supplier master records, automatically calculate revenue share splits upon checkout, track remaining consigned stock, and generate settlement invoices.

faqs.question: Can cashiers process sales when the internet goes down (Offline Mode)?
faqs.answer: Yes! Mitrasova POS is built on an Offline-First foundation. Cashiers process sales with zero delay without internet dependency. When the network reconnects, all transaction batches synchronize automatically with zero duplication risk.

faqs.question: What financial statements are generated by the Mitrasova POS accounting engine?
faqs.answer: Mitrasova POS generates complete audit-ready financial statements including Trial Balance, Profit & Loss (P&L), General Ledger, Automated Sales/Purchase Journals, and Cash Flow reports.

mitrasova-daya.title: Mitrasova Daya
mitrasova-daya.heroTagline: Platform HRIS, Payroll, & Presensi Geolocation Karyawan
mitrasova-daya.summary: Unified Workforce Platform: Automated Payroll & TER Tax Compliance, BPJS Integration, Anti-Fake GPS Attendance, and Employee Self-Service.
mitrasova-daya.description: Mitrasova Daya empowers HR leaders and enterprise executives to streamline their most valuable asset: People. Manage intricate shift rosters, automate instant payroll calculations with the latest Indonesian PPh 21 TER tax rules and BPJS contributions, process mobile leave/reimbursement requests, and evaluate employee KPIs transparently.

features.title: Automated Payroll & PPh 21 TER Tax Engine
features.description: Calculate thousands of employee salaries with up-to-date Indonesian TER tax brackets, BPJS deductions, allowances, and overtime rules in seconds.

features.title: Mobile Attendance with Geolocation & Liveness Check
features.description: Eliminate fraudulent clock-ins using AI-powered liveness face verification and precise workplace radius geofencing on employee mobile devices.

features.title: Employee Self-Service (ESS) Mobile Portal
features.description: Employees can request medical leave, annual vacations, overtime, reimbursement claims, and download encrypted digital payslips directly from their phones.

features.title: Flexible Shift Roster & KPI Performance Reviews
features.description: Configure dynamic rotating shift rosters for retail, hospitality, or manufacturing teams, with regular KPI metric evaluations and performance tracking.

faqs.question: Are payroll tax calculations compliant with the latest Indonesian TER regulations?
faqs.answer: Yes! The tax computation engine in Mitrasova Daya is continuously updated in accordance with the latest regulations from the Indonesian Ministry of Finance, guaranteeing statutory compliance.

faqs.question: What is the maximum employee capacity supported by Mitrasova Daya?
faqs.answer: Mitrasova Daya is built on a scalable cloud architecture capable of processing over 50,000 active employees with mass payslip generation taking under 2 minutes.

mitrasova-nexus.title: Mitrasova Nexus
mitrasova-nexus.heroTagline: High-Availability Cloud Hosting, Managed VPS & Security
mitrasova-nexus.summary: High-Performance Managed Cloud Hosting with Guaranteed 99.99% Uptime SLA, Advanced Anti-DDoS Mitigation, and Auto-Scaling Infrastructure.
mitrasova-nexus.description: Mitrasova Nexus is a managed cloud infrastructure solution engineered for enterprise mission-critical systems. Powered by secure Tier-4 data center networks in Jakarta & Singapore with ultra-low latency, NVMe PCIe 4.0 storage, multi-layered perimeter defense, and 24/7 proactive engineer monitoring.

features.title: Battle-Tested 99.99% Uptime SLA Guarantee
features.description: Multi-zone redundant cloud architecture engineered to keep enterprise business systems and web services online without disruption year-round.

features.title: Advanced Anti-DDoS Mitigation Defense
features.description: Automated defense against cyber threats and volumetric DDoS attacks on Layer 3, Layer 4, and Layer 7 with scrubbing centers mitigating up to 2 Tbps.

features.title: Automated Daily Cloud Backups & Rapid Disaster Recovery
features.description: Encrypted daily database and file snapshots replicated to off-site secondary locations with RPO and RTO measured in minutes.

features.title: Kubernetes Container Clustering & Auto-Scaling
features.description: Full support for Docker containerization and Kubernetes cluster orchestration to automatically scale node capacity during sudden traffic surges.

faqs.question: Where are the physical data center facilities located for Mitrasova Nexus?
faqs.answer: Our servers are hosted in Tier-4 certified facilities in Jakarta (Indonesia) and the Equinix SG1 Data Center (Singapore) to ensure the fastest internet interconnects and highest physical security.

faqs.question: Is there a 24/7 technical team monitoring system health?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our Network Operations Center (NOC) and cloud engineers monitor systems 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year with priority SLA response times.

From scalable modern application architectures, payment gateways, and legacy ERP integrations (SAP/Oracle) to high-performance native iOS & Android applications.

features.title: Legacy ERP System Integration & Secure API Gateways
features.description: Connect legacy databases (such as SAP, Oracle, or on-premise mainframes) with modern digital frontends via secure, high-throughput RESTful and GraphQL API pipelines.

features.title: Code Security Audits & Penetration Testing

features.title: Agile Sprint Methodology & Long-Term SLA Maintenance

faqs.question: What is the typical delivery timeline for custom software projects at Mitrasova Labs?
faqs.answer: Delivery schedules vary based on scope. Mid-sized MVP applications typically require 4–8 weeks, whereas complex integrated enterprise systems take 12–24 weeks with phased sprint milestones.

faqs.question: Does the client retain full ownership of the source code and Intellectual Property?
faqs.answer: Yes 100%. Upon project completion and final handover, all Intellectual Property (IP) rights, repositories, and source code become the exclusive property of your company.
